subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in global/per-agent iteration-budget contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485, and if so what should the final config names, budget unit, timeout behavior, and exhaustion result be?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the fix creates public config and runtime semantics that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
options.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.

options.title: Redesign the budget contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers design a different single budget model that covers turns, tool calls, and timeout-after-first-tool behavior.

options.title: Decline a core budget surface
options.body: Close this and associated budget requests only if maintainers decide existing loop detection, model choice, and prompt policy are the supported direction.

recommendation.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
recommendation.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned to the active implementation candidate and has already pushed follow-up work on the budget contract.
